liability.body: Flotta is a management tool: it reminds you of deadlines, it does not replace the agency’s legal obligations regarding insurance, roadworthiness, road tax or transport permits. Checking the documents remains the operator’s responsibility.
liability.title: Liability

property.body: The software, its documentation, icon set and texts belong to the publisher. Data entered by an agency remains that agency’s property and can be exported on request at any time.
property.title: Intellectual property

publisher.body:
TO BE COMPLETED BEFORE GOING LIVE: company name, legal form, capital, registered office, commercial register number, common company identifier (ICE) and publication manager.

These are deliberately not invented here: a fabricated register number would produce a false document wearing the appearance of a legal one.
publisher.title: Publisher

collected.body:
From the site: the demo form fields — name and phone (required), company, city, fleet size, email and message (optional).

A salted, truncated hash of your IP address is added. The address itself is never stored: the hash recognises automated submissions, it cannot lead back to you.

In the application: the data the agency enters — vehicles, customers, contracts, documents — and, if the agency installs trackers, the GPS positions of its own vehicles.
collected.title: Data collected

purpose.body:
Demo requests are used only to call you back. They are never sold, rented or passed to a third party for commercial purposes.

Application data is used to run the application. It is not exploited for any other purpose, and one agency never sees another agency’s data.
purpose.title: Use

retention.body:
Demo requests: kept for the duration of the sales follow-up, then deleted on request.

GPS positions: automatically purged beyond one year. This is a real deletion, not a flag.

Agency data: kept while the account exists, then for as long as accounting obligations require.
retention.title: Retention

rights.body:
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data, as well as an export of your agency’s data.

In Morocco, personal data processing is governed by law 09-08 and supervised by the CNDP, with which a complaint may be filed.
rights.title: Your rights

sharing.body:
Data is passed only to the technical providers needed to run the service: host, email delivery, and — if the agency uses one — its GPS tracker provider.

Demonstration workspaces never send anything outward: emails there are recorded and dropped, never delivered.
sharing.title: Recipients

site.heroBody: Insurance, roadworthiness, road tax, permits, contracts, deposits, fines, GPS trackers. Flotta watches every deadline and warns you before it costs you.

arabic.body: The whole interface flips, not just the text: margins, directional icons, column order. Amounts are formatted as `ar-MA`, whose separators differ from standard Arabic.
arabic.title: Right-to-left Arabic

money.body: Every amount is an integer number of cents carrying its own currency. An invoice rounding never drifts.
money.title: Dirhams to the cent

plates.body: Format "number | Arabic letter | region", with bidirectional isolation: the plate reads in the right order, even inside a French sentence.
plates.title: Moroccan plates

time.body: No hardcoded offset. Morocco moves back to UTC+0 during Ramadan: deadlines and same-day returns are computed in real local time.
time.title: Casablanca time
